guide.summary: Museums, a Tang palace site, and hotel restaurants, bars and lounges in Xi'an, checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Book Shaanxi History Museum tickets with your ID when the five-day window opens at 17:00, and plan around its Monday closure (Tuesday at the Qin-Han Branch), while the Xi'an Beilin Museum's visitor guide says it opens every day.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Shaanxi History Museum closes on Mondays and its Qin-Han Branch on Tuesdays, except on national statutory holidays. The Xi'an Beilin Museum's visitor guide says it opens every day of the week.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Shaanxi History Museum admission is free but needs a real-name booking through its WeChat account, opening five days ahead at 17:00; a missed booking blocks new bookings for 180 days. The Xi'an Beilin Museum also takes real-name bookings up to five days ahead and stops selling once the day's quota is reached.

toolkit.label: Walk-in rules
toolkit.copy: At the Shaanxi History Museum, visitors aged 65 and over can enter by scanning their ID card without booking. Children aged 6 and under, or 1.4 m and under, need no booking and enter with a booked adult, up to two per adult.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: The Xi'an Beilin Museum bans flash photography and lists tripods among prohibited items. The Ritz-Carlton, Xi'an lists a no-bathing-suits dress code at Xian Kitchen and Flair.

guide.dek: Book museum slots ahead with your ID, and plan your museum days around the Monday and Tuesday closures.
intro: Start with the Shaanxi History Museum on Xiaozhai East Road. Admission is free, but you still need a real-name ticket booked through its WeChat account. Booking opens five days ahead at 17:00, and a missed booking counts as a no-show that blocks new bookings for 180 days. Its winter hours, 9:00 to 17:30 with last entry at 16:30, run from 15 November 2026 to 14 March 2027, and the main museum closes on Mondays except on national statutory holidays. The Qin-Han Branch in Xixian New Area keeps 9:00 to 17:30 but closes on Tuesdays instead.

The Xi'an Beilin Museum at 15 Sanxuejie displays inscribed stone steles in its Forest of Steles galleries alongside a Stone Sculpture Hall, and its new building's permanent display was named among the national top ten museum exhibitions in May 2026. Its visitor guide says it opens every day of the week, with ticket sales and entry stopping at 17:00. You book with real-name ID up to five days ahead through its WeChat account, Alipay mini program or website, and sales stop once the day's quota is reached. Flash photography is not allowed, and tripods are on its prohibited-items list.

For prehistory, the Xi'an Banpo Museum at 155 Banpo Road shows prehistoric pottery and tools, with a pottery-making exhibition and a Prehistoric Workshop activity for children that you book by phone. Its hours page gives an 8:00 opening all year. East of the city in Lintong, Huaqing Palace at 3 Huaqing Road lists visiting hours from 7:30 on an undated page and sells tickets through its official WeChat account, mini program and online stores. Its evening show, The Song of Everlasting Sorrow, books up to ten days ahead through the same official channels.

For meals, hotel restaurants publish the clearest details. The Ritz-Carlton, Xi'an on Keji 2nd Road lists Xian Kitchen daily from 6:30 to 21:30, Cantonese-influenced Jing Xuan for lunch and dinner, teppanyaki at Tasuro from 17:30, and Flair, a rooftop bar reached by private elevator, open until 1:00, or 2:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. Its Lobby Lounge serves Afternoon Tea, pastries and cakes. At Sofitel Xi'an on Renmin Square, Azur serves breakfast from 6:00, Le Chinois cooks Shaanxi and Cantonese dishes, and Bar Bambu pours coffee and cocktails in the lobby.
summaryCards: Pair the Shaanxi History Museum, closed on Mondays, with the Xi'an Beilin Museum, which its visitor guide says opens every day.
Take breakfast at Azur in Sofitel Xi'an on Renmin Square from 6:00, then reach the Xi'an Beilin Museum well before ticket sales stop at 17:00.

Have your passport or ID ready, since the Shaanxi History Museum and the Xi'an Beilin Museum both need real-name bookings, and remember the Shaanxi History Museum closes on Mondays and its Qin-Han Branch on Tuesdays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several major sights could not be read by automated fetch and are left out: the Terracotta Warriors museum site (failed fetch and an http-only redirect), the City Wall (SSL error), Hanyangling Museum (TLS error), Daming Palace and the Bell and Drum Tower (DNS failures), the Tang West Market Museum (connection reset) and the Xi'an Museum at the Small Wild Goose Pagoda (no readable content); Shangri-La, Grand Hyatt, Westin, Hotel Indigo and Hilton pages returned 403 and % Arabica returned 418. Hours for the Xi'an Banpo Museum, Huaqing Palace and the Ritz-Carlton venues come from undated pages; the Accor hotel venues other than Azur's breakfast publish no hours, and their operating evidence is live hotel booking rather than dated notices. The Xi'an Beilin Museum's pages disagree on closing time (18:00 vs 18:30) and on ticket price, so neither price is stated. Xi'an's independent restaurants, cafés and bakeries rarely publish official websites, so dining, coffee and bakery picks are hotel venues; the bakery list uses lounges that serve pastries, cakes or desserts rather than true bakeries.

additions.method: The museum's site failed to load for automated reading during the review. It was then read on the museum's own home page in a browser; no review sites, maps or blogs were used.
